text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,030.35, up 2.01% on the day and 8.58% over the last five sessions, while Bank Nifty rose 2.27% to 59,086, marking a broad rally across the market. Advances (217) outnumbered declines (271) in the Nifty 500, giving a breadth score of 67.3 and a “healthy” zone, with 71.2% of stocks above their 20‑day moving average. The India VIX jumped 12.1% to 17.47, indicating higher short‑term volatility.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹13,749.82 crore today and a five‑day total of ₹45,960.02 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹5,968.70 crore (five‑day net –₹24,196.52 crore). The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.65 for Nifty, suggesting more put interest, with max‑pain at 24,700 and a call wall at 26,000. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.24, max‑pain at 57,200 and both call and put walls at 58,000, hinting at resistance around those levels.

Watch the 24,602 S1, 24,816 P and 25,244 R1 pivot points for Nifty and the 57,909 S1, 58,498 P and 59,674 R1 for Bank Nifty. Key headlines to monitor include the upcoming Q2 earnings (e.g., Hindalco, Voltas) and RBI’s variable‑rate repo auction on 9 Nov, which could influence liquidity and the INR‑USD rate that is currently at 93.89. Keep an eye on the USD‑INR trend and crude oil prices, as they have been supporting the rally.
